objections.id: critical for this file the supplied
objections.text: … critical for this file. The supplied diff audit is explicitly caller-supplied input and cannot repair the absent checkout binding. → Provide the exact candidate commit in the review checkout and regenerate all Sensei evidence against it.

objections.id: must pass claude output through while
objections.text: …must pass claude output through, while CLI.Run still emits raw lines that no reader-facing path may render directly — rather than as a prohibition the package already honours. Comment change only; no behaviour change and no new call site.

objections.id: e gap is in the evidence
objections.text: …e gap is in the evidence package, not in the code. → When handing off, attach the file-scoped preflight for each changed Go file rather than the task-only one, so the reviewer is given the classification the receipt itself says to obtain.

objections.id: and attach sensei preflight file internal
objections.text: … and attach `sensei preflight --file internal/agent/agent.go` and `sensei briefing --file internal/agent/agent.go` rather than the task-only preflight, and re-run `sensei bootstrap` so the published snapshot stops trailing the working tree.

objections.id: normalize the tool name the same
objections.text: … → Normalize the tool name the same way the prose is normalized: `strings.Join(strings.Fields(block.Name), " ")`, so both value sources into the rendered line are held to the single-line property by construction rather than by assumption.

objections.id: es arbitrary byte strings deeply nested
objections.text: …es, arbitrary byte strings, deeply nested JSON — asserting only that Activity("claude", x) is either empty or free of envelope punctuation. That form can fail, and so would prove the universal claim the current guard only appears to make.

objections.id: paired with a forbidden fix for
objections.text: … paired with a forbidden_fix for rendering event.Output directly on a reader-facing path — or reduce the comment to the descriptive half and drop the 'must'/'may not' clauses, so the file does not assert authority it has not been granted.
